tool.description: Search KB entities for discovery using legacy lexical ranking or deterministic intent-v1 ranking. Intent mode accepts host-agent semantic facets and source locations, returns evidence and abstains below its confidence threshold. Use for exploratory lookup before exact follow-up with kb_query. No mutation side effects.

limit.description: Optional max rows to return after ranking. Default: 20.

minScore.description: Intent-v1 acceptance threshold between 0 and 1. Low-confidence queries abstain instead of returning misleading matches.

query.description: Free-text query for metadata and markdown body discovery. Example: 'OAuth login flow'.

rankingMode.description: Optional deterministic ranking mode. Omit for backward-compatible lexical search; use intent-v1 for semantic facets, source-aware evidence, graph boosts, and abstention.

semanticFacets.description: Optional host-agent semantic interpretation. Kibi uses these strings as deterministic aliases/facets; it does not call a model itself.

sourceLocations.description: Optional changed-code locations. Results are matched to source-linked symbols/entities and include source evidence.

type.description: Optional entity type filter to narrow discovery. Example: 'req'.

tool.name: kb_search
